name: N_DIO
notes: DIO_Theory: DIO cross-section / form-factor uncertainty. Apply as Gaussian constraint on N_DIO.

name: N_RPC
notes: RPC_Rate: RPC stopping power and composition uncertainty. Apply as constraint on N_RPC.; Pion_Rate: Pion production in RPC affects RPC yield; asymmetric from Geant4 studies.

name: N_Cosmic
notes: CRV_Efficiency: Cosmic ray veto efficiency affects cosmic yield; from CRV detector studies (SU2020).; Cosmic_Generator: Cosmic ray generator model differences affect cosmic yield; measured via cross-comparison.

name: c1_Cosmic
notes: c1_Cosmic: Gaussian prior on Chebyshev coefficient c1 for Cosmic poly2 spectrum shape.

name: c2_Cosmic
notes: c2_Cosmic: Gaussian prior on Chebyshev coefficient c2 for Cosmic poly2 spectrum shape.
